# QuantumFeatureSpace

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The high-dimensional Hilbert space into which classical data is embedded by quantum feature maps, enabling linear separation of complex patterns. Understanding this space allows TCC/iNEST researchers to design topology-aware quantum encodings that align with network data distributions.
